```{ojs}

monthly_means = {
    const data = [3.2,2.9,3.7,3.5,3.8,3.9,4.3,4.4,3.8,3.3,3,3.4,]
    return data;
}

function makeInputs() {
    const data = [];
    for (let i=0; i<12; i++) {
        data.push(Inputs.range([0,12], {step:0.1, value:monthly_means[i], label: `Month ${i}`}));
    }
    return data;
}

function getTotal(monthly, usage, storage) {
    let total = 0;
    for (let i=0; i <12; i++) {
        total += monthly[i].value;
    }
    return storage + total - usage;
}

input_list = makeInputs();

viewof months = Inputs.form(input_list);

balance = {
    yield getTotal(input_list, 900, 3000);
}
```
